You are a code worker editing the freytag-forge repo. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge; edit files here directly and ONLY the files you own. Never edit /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge itself. Do NOT git commit and do NOT touch .git. No network calls, no billed runs, never call the real OpenAI API (tests use injected fetch fakes).

OWNED FILES: frontend/e2e/judge-journeys.js, frontend/e2e/judge-journeys.test.js, frontend/e2e/roleplay-judge.js, frontend/e2e/roleplay-judge.test.js.

BACKGROUND: The journey judge (frontend/e2e/judge-journeys.js buildSceneJudgments) tells the canon judge which knowledge the player has EARNED by passing `revealedKnowledgeIds`, computed today as the union of every turn's `grounding_ids` (what the narration cited), including turns that were REJECTED. That is wrong in both directions: grounding_ids is not the set of committed reveals, and rejected turns committed nothing. Each blind-player turn record (frontend/e2e/blind-player.js turnRecord) also carries `attempt_bundle` (typed by storygame/runtime/attempt_bundle.py): `outcome` is 'committed' | 'rejected' | 'game_break' | 'operational_failure', and `selected_reveal.knowledge_ids` / `selected_reveal.delivery_fact_ids` list what the runtime really committed as a reveal on that turn; `committed_delta.fact_predicates` lists committed facts.

CHANGES:
1. buildSceneJudgments: compute `revealedKnowledgeIds` (sorted, de-duplicated) from COMMITTED reveal evidence: for each turn that is not rejected and whose attempt_bundle.outcome is 'committed', take attempt_bundle.selected_reveal.knowledge_ids. For turns with NO attempt_bundle at all (reports recorded before bundles existed), fall back to that turn's grounding_ids only if the turn is not rejected, and mark the scene judgment with `reveal_evidence: 'grounding_fallback'` (use 'committed_bundles' when every counted turn had a bundle, 'mixed' otherwise). Rejected, game_break and operational_failure turns contribute nothing. Never let a turn's grounding_ids ADD to a committed turn's set: for a turn with a bundle, the bundle alone is the evidence. Keep every other output field and the skip behavior unchanged.
2. Update the existing test in judge-journeys.test.js whose expectation encoded the old behavior (it expects the rejected turn's 'bad' id), and add tests for: committed bundle ids used; rejected turn ignored; grounding_ids ignored when a bundle exists; fallback and the reveal_evidence marker; mixed reports.
3. roleplay-judge.js judgeSceneNarration system prompt: separate genuine premature disclosure from invented facts. Add to the system message plain-worded instructions that (a) `revealed_knowledge` is the set of authored facts the player has earned by committed reveal, (b) premature disclosure means narration that states an authored protected fact NOT in revealed_knowledge, and only that fails protected_safe, (c) an ordinary invented detail that is not an authored protected fact (a color, a minor object, a bit of atmosphere) is not premature disclosure and must not fail protected_safe; contradiction of established canon still fails canon_consistent. Do not change CANON_SCHEMA, the seven checks, or the scoring. Do not rewrite the rest of the prompt. Add a test using the injected fetchImpl that asserts the request body's system message contains the new guidance (match on distinctive substrings you added) and that the schema is unchanged.

HOW TO RUN: from the worktree, `ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/frontend/node_modules frontend/node_modules` if frontend/node_modules is missing (it is gitignored), then `cd frontend && node --test e2e/judge-journeys.test.js e2e/roleplay-judge.test.js`. Match surrounding style. Write short notes to /home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/stage2-notes/journey-judge-notes.md.
